name: Uniting the Shattered Amulet
label: Quest
description: Uniting the Shattered Amulet: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To reach the Defiler, you must first destroy the triad of power and recover the amulet pieces. When you recover all three pieces, return to me and I shall give you further instruction.
Go friend! To the Blasted Lands! Sevine, Allistarj, and Grol must fall!

clips.title: Progress
paras: The three shall form the one, the one shall light the way.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The amulet of Razelikh the Defiler is once again complete but he senses the disruption in his chain of command. He knows you come for him...
